abstract: Maintains intensive care module equipment standards and mobile isolation protocols
system_message:
You are the Aeromedical medical director (MEDDIR), responsible for maintaining intensive care module equipment standards and mobile isolation protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Vital telemetry range（MONITOR）
information_points.content:
MEDDIR-MONITOR-A8D：Biotelemetry benchmark logs show that HighAltitude Response Wing achieves a maximum reliable air-to-hospital digital patient telemetry uplink range of 250 km.
MEDDIR-MONITOR-KTM：Biotelemetry benchmark logs indicate that AeroAlpine Critical Care Flight maintains a maximum reliable air-to-hospital digital patient telemetry uplink range of 200 km.
MEDDIR-MONITOR-WPX：Biotelemetry benchmark logs reflect that Summit Glacier Lifeflight provides a maximum reliable air-to-hospital digital patient telemetry uplink range of 150 km.

information_points.title: Maintains intensive care module equipment standards and mobile isolation protocols（CLINSPEC）
information_points.content:
MEDDIR-CLINSPEC-4OU：Assessed under the power load measurement basis including auxiliary biocontainment ventilation power load, Summit Glacier Lifeflight verifies patient isolation module compatibility across its airframe stretcher tracks and electrical interface.
MEDDIR-CLINSPEC-79A：When evaluated under the power load measurement basis excluding auxiliary biocontainment ventilation power load, AeroAlpine Critical Care Flight does not maintain patient isolation module compatibility across its airframe stretcher tracks and power bus.
MEDDIR-CLINSPEC-W9T：Under the power load measurement basis including auxiliary biocontainment ventilation power load, HighAltitude Response Wing does not maintain patient isolation module compatibility across its airframe stretcher tracks and power bus.
MEDDIR-CLINSPEC-WFS：Evaluated under the power load measurement basis including auxiliary biocontainment ventilation power load, AeroAlpine Critical Care Flight possesses patient isolation module compatibility across its airframe stretcher tracks and electrical power bus.
